facts.text: American Flag was deployed at Fra Mauro during Apollo 14 in 1971.
Planted during EVA-1 near the Lunar Module. Shepard, America's first man in space, was now the oldest person to walk on the Moon at age 47.
Engineered specifically to operate in the harsh vacuum and extreme temperatures of the lunar environment.
Documented the surface conditions and served as a photographic reference for reconstructing the EVA timeline and crew movements at Fra Mauro.
Status: Remains preserved in the arid regolith at Fra Mauro.
LROC images from 2011 show the Apollo 14 flag still casts a shadow, indicating it remains standing.
